request.text:
labels: Three visible hair sections interweave into a repeated braid below a tie point, while a neighboring loose lock only curves in waves without interlacing.; 묶임점 아래 세 머리 묶음이 반복 교차해 땋임을 이루고 옆의 풀린 가닥은 교차 없이 물결 모양으로 휜다.
definition: Complete optional school-life visual realization: Three visible hair sections interweave into a repeated braid below a tie point, while a neighboring loose lock only curves in waves without interlacing.
aliases: 브레이드와 웨이브의 구별
